name: Falling For You
source:
Soo Yun had always wanted to be like her mom and dad, managing newcomer idols and bringing them up to stardom! However, her parents wanted her to have a normal life and forbid her from managing any stars. Soo Yun's dreams seemed to be down the toilet, until her dad fell sick! Now Soo Yun is in charge with three new idols with three completely different personalities! Can she juggle bringing these idols to stardom and have a budding romance? Will she be able to deal with all the drama and scandals that come with fame? Find out for yourself and see who will be falling for you. -Heavily based on the Korean dramas Heartstrings and You're Beautiful-

translation:
秀妍一直想像爸爸妈妈一样，管理新人偶像，把他们培养成明星！然而，她的父母希望她过正常的生活，不许她管理任何明星。秀云的梦想似乎落入了马桶，直到她爸爸生病了！现在秀妍掌管着三位性格完全不同的三位新偶像！她能否兼顾将这些偶像带入明星之路并拥有一段初露端倪的恋情？她能应对名声带来的所有戏剧性事件和丑闻吗？亲自找出来，看看谁会爱上你。-主要改编自韩剧《心弦》和《原来是美男》-
